chapter: Jazz at the Philharmonic and life on the road
title: 'Life has been very nice to me': no soap opera stories
summary: Dance quotes a Leonard Feather piece saying Humes would not give dramatics. Humes says she remembers only good things, with no drugs, just bingo, cards and meeting people.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Yeah. You know there are alot of nice things about being in this business. That is if you try to do the nice things. Because I don't try to get into all the off-the-wall stuff.

I was just looking at a piece that Leonard Feather did on you one time and the closes the piece by saying, you were saying they couldn't get a story out of you like on Billie Holiday, no dramatics, no terrible things, no soap operas, and you ended up saying something, ' I just like all the nice things in life. Life has been very nice to me.'
I said, nobody want to read no stories about me because all I remember is just the good things

in life. I mean, no drugs, nothing that would interest anybody. Because I mean, just sitting down going to bingo, playing cards, seeing the people and meeting people. Nobody want to hear nothing about me.
I'll tell you there is one thing about musician's life and entertainer's life too, and that is, you come up against all these different personalities and there are alot of funny things.
And so that you have a constanct little humor going on, like who did what and who said what.
